units.P-exact: An exact window of the record is found: count mode counts at least the record's context; all_or_count lists the record's contexts at their offsets.
units.P-placed: With labels (predicate_only or all) the record is placed at the window (nt_coords) and its taxid is among the labels.
units.P-scope-suffix: suffix scope finds the record's context at offset k-L.
units.P-scope-start: The first 20 bases of a record are found in any_offset scope; the suffix scope's contexts are among them (relation subset).
units.P-scope-strands: strands forward lists only + contexts; strands reverse with the reverse complement lists the record as a - context.
units.P-scope-palindrome: A 16 bp palindrome is searched once and reported with strand '='.
units.P-iupac-codes: A 25-mer with 2-4 IUPAC codes holding the record's bases finds the record's contexts.
units.P-iupac-nrun: A run of N, leading or internal, is skipped; the record is still found.
units.P-modes: count gives no list; partial cuts at max_contexts; all_or_count withholds above the threshold; a cap above the limit is lowered and stated; stop_at_threshold; max_contexts 0 returns nothing and says cut (relation subset: the cut list within the complete one).
units.P-negative: A random 31-mer or a shuffled 40-mer is absent: exact 0, complete.
units.P-floor: Patterns below the information floor are refused as such; suffix scope is exempt and a 24-bit IUPAC pattern at the floor is answered.
units.P-caps: max_anchors 0, max_steps 1 / 50 and a 300 ms budget over 16 patterns stop or cut exactly where stated.
units.P-edge: Malformed pattern lists are refused with the host's text; lower case, duplicate ids and in_ram are accepted as documented.
units.P-more: IUPAC codes at the first and last position still find the record; partial with a cap above the count returns the complete list without a cut.
units.P-heavy: A 12- or 16-mer in any_offset scope (heavy): the count is at least the record's contexts.
units.P-twin: The upper-case twin answers as the lower-case test (same_answer); the exact window's contexts are among its IUPAC pattern's (subset).
